title: Felix and the Bakery
author: Mara Blackwood
blurb: Rafael Montrose, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
